# Leslie Moore

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty-eight  <sub>[v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 c10 P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c40 P50](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0050)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** former schoolteacher, keeps summer boarders  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Leslie  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Leslie is an exceptionally beautiful young woman with sea-blue eyes, a splendid head of hair that gleams like molten gold and reaches to her feet, and slender, brown hands. She has a fine, spirited figure and arms that gleam like ivory-tinted marble. She often wears a plain dress with a customary girdle or touch of crimson somewhere about her person.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c21 P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c26 P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 c33 P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Leslie possesses a glowing, pent-up personality beneath a proud, resolute, and sometimes reserved exterior. She is clever, lively, and witty among close companions, though she can be uncommunicative and stiff when defensive or unhappy. She has a deep sense of duty and loyalty to her family, bearing hardships stoically and strongly disliking being pitied.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c23 P33](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0033), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c30 P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)_

## History

Leslie grew up in Four Winds, enduring early family tragedies when her younger brother died in an accident and her father committed suicide. After attending Queen's Academy and teaching school, she was coerced at sixteen into marrying Dick Moore to keep her mother from being evicted from her home. Following her mother's death and Dick's departure at sea, Dick returned as a brain-damaged invalid, whom Leslie loyally cared for over eleven years in quiet poverty. Upon becoming close friends with Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe, she agreed to Gilbert's suggestion to take Dick to Montreal for brain surgery. The operation revealed that the man was actually Dick's double-cousin, George Moore, leaving Leslie free from her tragic marriage. She fell in love with Owen Ford, who later proposed to her, and she subsequently planned her future alongside her beloved friends.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c30 P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- daughter of Frank West and Rose Elliott  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- lost her four-year-younger brother Kenneth to a farm accident at age twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- found her father after he committed suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- inherited money from her grandmother West to attend Queen's Academy  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- completed two years' work in one year at Queen's Academy and taught at Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- was coerced into marrying Dick Moore at sixteen to save her mother's home from foreclosure  <sub>[v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026)</sub>
- lost her mother to pneumonia the spring after her marriage  <sub>[v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>

## Quotes

> If we are to be friends you must call me Leslie  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

> I ENVY Anne, and I’d envy her even if she had died! She was a mother for one beautiful day. I’d gladly give my life for THAT!  <sub>[v4 c19 P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028)</sub>

> Anne, you don’t know how GOOD it is to be sitting here with you again—working—and talking—and being silent together.  <sub>[v4 c21 P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000)</sub>

> I find one doesn’t get over being a fool very quickly. Sometimes I think there are people who are fools forever. And to be a fool—of that kind—is almost as bad as being a—a dog on a chain.  <sub>[v4 c33 P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014)</sub>
